images.name: 초승달 궁정
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone fantasy MMORPG longbow concept for the 'Blue Moon Twilight' series, expressing noble blue elegance. Render ONE complete upright longbow, not a sheet or a collage. Clean orthographic side/front elevation showing the whole bow silhouette and its center grip; the straight delicate bowstring is on the RIGHT. Portrait composition with clear margins around both tips. Very dark navy clean plain background. No person, no hand, no arrow, no labels, no text, no watermark. The weapon must visually be deep azure sapphire and iridescent pale-blue moonstone/opal, not gray iron sprayed blue. Silver is allowed only as extremely thin restrained edging. The BLUE MOON is part of the structural silhouette itself, not a flat attached moon badge. Elegant sophisticated game weapon concept illustration with coherent dimensional facets, sharpened graceful tips, readable solid contour, minimal external glow; no floating particles, no excessive halo, no excessive filigree that obscures the silhouette. Unique design: CRESCENT COURT. A single enormous sweeping crescent forms nearly the entire bow's body, an expansive noble lunar C-shape opening to the right. The center grip crosses the open side cleanly; the continuous crescent has deep cobalt outer spine and a broad glowing opal inner crescent. Make it a confident simple regal silhouette with one dominant moon and only two elegantly recurved end tips. The center moon form must read from a small game camera. Avoid bird wings, orbit rings, branching crown spikes, and symmetrical multiple decorative crescents.
images.model: built-in default; model identifier not exposed by tool

review.notes: Broad lunar C-shaped body; two great opal crescents connect around a centered grip. Cleanest and broadest moon silhouette.
